versions.content: Service Name CanIf_GetPduMode Syntax Std_ReturnType CanIf_GetPduMode ( uint8 ControllerId, CanIf_PduModeType * PduModePtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x0a Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant (Not for the same channel) Parameters (in) ControllerId All PDUs of the own ECU connected to the corresponding CanIf ControllerId, which is assigned to a physical CAN controller are addressed. 5 85 of 215 Document ID 12: AUTOSAR_SWS_CANInterface Specification of CAN Interface AUTOSAR CP R20-11 4 Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) PduModePtr Pointer to a memory location, where the current mode of the logical PDU channel will be stored. Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: PDU mode request has been accepted E_NOT_OK: PDU mode request has not been accepted Description This service reports the current mode of a requested PDU channel. Available via CanIf.h
